preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 1000.
Each string s must have a length between 1 and 50.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ' for c in s)
preconditions.description: Each character in the string s must be a Latin letter.

postconditions.description: The output for each test case must be either 'YES' or 'NO'.
If the output is 'YES', the string s must be a substring of 'Yes' repeated many times.

postconditions.expression: any(s not in 'Yes' * 100 for _ in range(t))
postconditions.description: If the output is 'NO', the string s must not be a substring of 'Yes' repeated many times.
